capabilities: Pull and push wiki and timeline articles via the BackDrop API
Resolve sync conflicts with line-level diffs and keep-local/take-remote choices
Insert images, audio, wikilinks, and spoiler wraps from editor header actions
Edit article properties such as status, category, characters, and thumbnails
Rewrite slug wikilinks to note titles on pull and back to slugs on publish
disambiguation: Not a general backup or multi-device sync tool; it only syncs notes with the backdrop.quest BackDrop service.
extras: Manual developer-style install (npm install && npm run install:vault) is described in the README, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. README documents Live Preview rendering limits for aligned images and remote-image settings requirements.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull, push, or resolve conflicts for articles on the BackDrop wiki platform, whose slug-based links and asset URLs don't map cleanly onto a vault.

relations.evidence: open a selective push panel (Obsidian Sync–style checklist)

summary: Two-way sync between a vault and backdrop.quest wiki/timeline articles, with conflict resolution, editor helpers, and slug-to-title wikilink rewriting.
